# estimate_iact { #deep_tensor.estimate_iact }

```python
estimate_iact(xs: Tensor)
```

Estimates the integrated autocorrelation time of each parameter 
within a simulated Markov chain.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**xs**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A num_steps * num_params matrix containing the simulated Markov  chain.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**taus**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A vector containing the estimates of the IACT for each  parameter.
